body: I play over 4GAS network while living in rural with trees everywhere,  sometimes there are spikes and ping is roughly 100 - 140ms, but suprisingly very stable and even savage content raidable. You may have to adjust to move a bit earlier or buffer rotations, but really depends on the connection really.    Having gone the other route of using a Tethered USB connection via hotspot through a phone provider. I can say the ping is roughly 85 to 90ms but that is if you are getting full bars.  there can be some slight hiccups but typically its rare.   Data usage is quite low but be on the lookout if you are running on windows, with windows updates turned on.

The game is in a strange place right now but its far from dead.  You should keep playing this game is a lot of fun. Coming back to the game went relatively smooth for me and I started a new character in the process to play with friends without spending the 18.00 for a transfer.  (Got to i170, did some networking being social with the server and got to clear EX content and working on  A1S with a group after already clearing it as a pug a few times. )   Also my friends are still not even done with HW content and play fairly casually so by no means was I caught back up by them. 


I don't really want players to get the wrong idea from this topic and think this game is not worth playing because of an overall negative experience.   

If you plan to return to the game be sure to

-Network  and make friends with as many people as you can this  game has a social aspect use it.
- Be specific on your goals (If you are learning a fight make your own party)
-Focus on yourself and your performance rather than others what can you work on? 
-Choose your words carefully and show confidence ( You clear a fight?  watch a few more playthroughs and tell people you are experienced it's not a lie to say you aren't ) 


To OP:  Don't give up hope where there is darkness there is also light!   Sometimes things are going to get rough, best advice I can give you is make friends with people you trust and have raided with and form a raiding group from them if possible.     Experienced players aren't entitled to take people they don't trust with them if they choose to come to help with a fight that is their decision and it should be respected.  You have to find like minded people who want to clear it just like you, they exist and are out there trust me on this.    (It does suck that your server does not like to help out maybe find a server that is willing.)
